pairing_tier_semantics: same-truth, same estimand; only the observation map changes
interval_semantics: Reported 95% bootstrap and Wilson intervals are pointwise Monte Carlo uncertainty intervals for their individual estimands. They are not simultaneous family-wise confidence bands over all V3 contrasts.
sesoi_role: preregistered SESOI / decision-relevance reference magnitudes, NOT gates

v2_like_corner.role: External-consistency diagnostic only. NOT a numeric replication gate. Hard implementation validation comes from legacy-mode G1R1/G2R3/G3R3 bit-for-bit parity.
